title: Television, rock and roll, and his brother Jules's showmanship
summary: He blames television for music that is judged by eye, and discusses his brother's personality and how he built his own style from others.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: Is jazz healthy? Young players, rock and the future
